result:
Here's how I read it: members with a booked lane get a text at 18:00 the evening before, so fewer lanes sit empty while people on the waiting list miss out. Anyone who ticked "no texts, please" gets no texts from the club, including these reminders.

What I found in the booking app:

- **Nothing sends reminders yet.** The club already texts its newsletter through an SMS provider, so the sending side exists and reminders can reuse it.
- **No-text members get no reminder at all.** 23% of members have `no_texts` set, so under the spec as written, nearly a quarter of members get nothing. Email can't fully cover the gap: 61% of members have no email address. I haven't checked how many no-text members do have one.

The open question is what no-text members should get:

- **Nothing.** This follows the spec exactly and is simplest, but those bookings get no help against no-shows.
- **An email reminder, where we have an address.** It respects their choice about texts and reaches some of them. It adds an email path to build and maintain.

I'd pick the email reminder, since cutting no-shows is the point. Which do you want?

Correct anything I've got wrong above. Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
